sessions.phase_label: Magazine design, revision, digital launch, and source-file handoff

requirements.title: Magazine Layout Template
requirements.definition: Create the reusable page template used to structure and typeset the magazine.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers creation of the layout template itself; editable-source handoff, overall issue assembly, visual branding, and individual article presentation rules are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Cohesive Issue Layout Assembly
requirements.definition: Arrange and typeset the supplied articles, images, advertisements, and other content into a cohesive magazine following the current Flat Plan.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers overall page structure, article flow, and arrangement of the issue; font choice, metadata blocks, specific required pages, navigation, and output formats remain independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Polished Civic Lantern Visual Style
requirements.definition: Give the magazine a polished, modern visual treatment consistent with Civic Lantern branding.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the issue-wide visual direction and brand consistency, not independently specified font, image-quality, advertisement-quality, or article-specific color rules.

requirements.title: Website Article Sourcing
requirements.definition: Gather the magazine article content directly from the Civic Lantern website.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the required content source; decisions about which additional articles must be included and where they are placed are separate.

requirements.title: Article Author Identity
requirements.definition: Display each article author's name and the correct corresponding author photograph.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers author identity and correct photo selection; the portrait's circular shape and visual size are separately modifiable presentation behavior.

requirements.title: Author Photo Presentation
requirements.definition: Present each author photograph as a small circular portrait of an appropriate visual size.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated from author identity because portrait sizing and shape can fail or change independently of whether the correct author is shown.

requirements.title: Article Category Labels
requirements.definition: Display the appropriate category for every article as a visually suitable label alongside the title and author information.
requirements.boundary_note: The category list and category-to-article mappings are attributes of one labeling mechanism rather than separate Requirements for every category or article.

requirements.title: Readable Article Body Typography
requirements.definition: Use an article-body font treatment that is readable, sufficiently substantial, and gentle on the eyes.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers body-font family, weight, and readability as one typography mechanism; it excludes issue-wide branding and unrelated decorative typography.

requirements.title: Balanced Article Endings
requirements.definition: Avoid large empty white areas at article endings by using appropriate subject-related images or other accepted editorial elements only where needed.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently testable article-ending balance behavior, including placement of supplied page-specific filler images; requests for more images are supporting workflow rather than a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Dorian Vale Article Color Restriction
requirements.definition: Do not use the strong red cover color for the Dorian Vale article; reserve that red treatment for the cover.
requirements.boundary_note: This article-specific color restriction can be changed or checked independently of the magazine's broader visual style.

requirements.title: Cover-Mentioned Article Inclusion
requirements.definition: Include and appropriately place the three articles mentioned on the cover but omitted from the Flat Plan.
requirements.boundary_note: The three articles form one explicitly requested content-addition set with a shared placement decision; unrelated required pages remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Tribute Page Inclusion
requirements.definition: Include the supplied tribute page toward the end of the magazine.
requirements.boundary_note: The tribute page has its own required content and placement and can be included or changed independently of other article additions.

requirements.title: Advertise Page Inclusion
requirements.definition: Include the supplied Advertise with Civic Lantern page in the magazine.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a specific required page whose presence can be checked independently; general advertisement rendering quality is a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Accurate Final Table of Contents
requirements.definition: Complete the table of contents only after pagination is finalized and ensure that its article listings and page numbers are accurate.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the accuracy and finalization of the contents page; clickable navigation behavior is independently testable and remains separate.

requirements.title: Accurate Cover Page References
requirements.definition: Show accurate final page numbers for the articles featured on the magazine cover.
requirements.boundary_note: Cover references can be updated or fail independently of the table of contents and therefore are not an attribute of the contents-page Requirement.

requirements.title: Interactive Contents Navigation
requirements.definition: Provide hyperlinks from contents entries to their chapters and return links from chapters or page numbers to the contents page.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers interactive link behavior, which can be implemented and verified independently of whether the displayed contents information is accurate.

requirements.title: Digital Flipbook PDF
requirements.definition: Deliver a PDF suitable for use as the digital magazine flipbook.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers production of the upload-ready digital artifact; spread compatibility, hosting branding, preview-file restrictions, and print output are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Print-Ready Magazine Output
requirements.definition: Produce a press-quality print version with appropriate resolution, trim, bleed, sizing, and safe-zone handling when that output remains in scope.
requirements.boundary_note: Resolution, trim, bleed, resizing, and safe zones are tightly coupled prepress attributes of the print output; the Requirement remains historically relevant despite being removed from current scope.

requirements.title: Flipbook Spread Compatibility
requirements.definition: Ensure the digital publication has a balanced page structure that works correctly as two-page flipbook spreads, including an even page count.
requirements.boundary_note: Spread behavior and page-count parity have their own acceptance criterion and can fail independently of whether a PDF is otherwise generated.

requirements.title: Flipbook Platform and Branding Workflow
requirements.definition: Use an acceptable flipbook platform and manage platform branding or white-label presentation through the selected account and upload workflow.
requirements.boundary_note: Platform selection, visible host branding, white-label access, and who performs the upload are coupled parts of one hosting workflow; PDF generation itself remains separate.

requirements.title: Heyzine Upload File Selection
requirements.definition: Keep preview-only copies separate from the final Heyzine-ready PDF and upload only the designated final version.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a file-selection constraint for deployment of the artifact, not a generic delivery-status or project-management Requirement.

requirements.title: Publication Image Quality
requirements.definition: Improve low-resolution or otherwise unsuitable publication images, using AI or vectorization when necessary, so they render professionally.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers technical image-quality correction across the publication; advertisement rendering and article-end image placement have separate acceptance behavior.

requirements.title: Advertisement Rendering Quality
requirements.definition: Ensure supplied advertisements appear clear, correctly sized, and professionally rendered rather than blurry or improperly prepared.
requirements.boundary_note: Advertisement repair and sizing have a distinct failure and correction trajectory from general publication imagery and from the presence of a specific Advertise page.

requirements.title: Issue Date and Edition Label
requirements.definition: Present the correct publication month and issue date for the inaugural issue in the magazine artifact.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the date or edition information rendered in the publication; launch deadlines and freelancer delivery schedules are excluded as project-management state.

requirements.title: Editable Template and Source-File Handoff
requirements.definition: Deliver the editable magazine template and associated project source files to the client.
requirements.boundary_note: Source-file transfer is independently required after the finished publication and can be completed separately from creating the template or delivering the final PDFs.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer describes a 160-page magazine, while the opening project description says approximately 100 pages or fewer; the supplied messages do not contain a clear client confirmation of the final page-count constraint.
The freelancer proposes publication-wide punctuation normalization, but the client asks for clarification without clearly authorizing a complete copy-editing requirement.

The client says the issue would need to change to December after the missed launch window, but the exchange immediately returns to a same-day launch; whether the rendered issue date actually changed requires adjudication.
